candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A broad personal neurological-history question covering prior speech, visual or bladder episodes; do not require naming specific hidden symptoms.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Included in the questions proposed in section 4 of the written response

candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Open questions about onset, progression or what worsens symptoms; do not require the words 'hot bath'.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Included in the questions proposed in section 4 of the written response
